findings.evidence: Lines 84-90, 140-178 carry no `/-- -/`. The repo convention is a docstring on every lemma, including trivial ones: `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:80` documents even `orderedProdIntegral_zero` ("The zero-fold ordered integral is the empty product"), and every other declaration in that file and in this one is documented.
findings.fix: Add a one-line docstring to each, and for the `add` lemmas state why the integrability hypotheses are needed (additivity of the interval integral fails for junk values) while `smul` needs none.
findings.issue: Eight public theorems have no docstring: `plusFunctional_def` (84), `plusOneMinus_def` (88), `plusFunctional_smul_left` (141), `plusFunctional_smul_right` (147), `plusOneMinus_smul` (154), `plusFunctional_add_left` (157), `plusFunctional_add_right` (164), `plusOneMinus_add` (174). The linearity lemmas are not merely name-evident: `smul` is unconditional while `add` requires integrability of each summand's integrand, and nothing on the page explains that asymmetry.

findings.evidence: Lines 31-42 list only `intervalIntegrable_mul_sub`, `plusFunctional_const`, `plusFunctional_mul_right` and `plusOneMinus_pow`; the file also proves lines 141-178 and 183-189.
findings.fix: Add bullets for the linearity lemmas and for `plusFunctional_eq_integral_sub_mul_integral` to the Main results section.
findings.issue: The "Main results" list omits linearity (`plusFunctional_smul_left/right`, `plusFunctional_add_left/right`) and `plusFunctional_eq_integral_sub_mul_integral`, so a reader scanning the header does not learn that the functional is proved linear or that it splits as `K - (∫₀¹ K) δ(1-z)` — both advertised as deliverables of this file.

summary: The module docstring and the main theorems are accurate and well motivated, with no overclaiming. But eight public theorems — including the whole linearity API the PR advertises — have no docstring at all, against the file's own and the repo's convention.
